title: Rotating Thin Shells in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity
summary: A rotating metric solution in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity with a negative cosmological constant was recently found in the Chern-Simons point. We construct a rotating thin shell gluing two spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity, using the Davis junction conditions. We take the inner and outer spacetimes as replicas of the same rotating metric, with different values of mass and angular momentum.
